reply_text: I replied in #coastal-team to your message. The official handoff date for the CRM is 03.11.2025, based on Moss's 02.11.2025 digest and Bettina's 08.12.2025 cutover recap. The recap also says you took over day-to-day on 22.11.2025. The digest only records the planned date, so 03.11.2025 is the one to use.
